Birthday girl Lovlina makes history with gold, joins Mary Kom in elite club
articles.summary: Lovlina Borgohain made history by clinching a gold medal at the Asian Games, becoming just the second Indian woman boxer to achieve this feat. She delivered an impressive performance, sweeping the finals against China's Ziyi Bao with a perfect 5-0 score.

articles.title: Ambulance stopped for CM Himanta’s convoy: 4 Assam cops suspended
articles.summary: Four traffic cops in Silchar were suspended for briefly halting an ambulance to clear a path for CM Himanta Biswa Sarma. The incident occurred while attempting to transport a critically ill patient to the hospital.

articles.title: Ford CEO Jim Farley makes clear distinction of the jobs that AI cannot replace
articles.summary: Ford's CEO Jim Farley emphasized that artificial intelligence will complement skilled trades workers, assuring that roles requiring hands-on skills and practical judgment are safe despite AI advancements. He pointed out that fostering trust is crucial for the successful collaboration between workers and AI.

Scientists released fluorescent dye nearly 2 km underwater; it revealed deep water rising 100 metres a day
articles.summary: Researchers utilized fluorescein dye in the Rockall Trough to study deep ocean water upwelling. They measured rapid upward movement reaching about 125 metres per day, significantly faster than average estimates.

articles.title: Jack Johnson’s foundation transformed neglected Hawaii farmland into a thriving farm for students
articles.summary: Kōkua Hawaiʻi Foundation acquired unused farmland on Oʻahu in 2019 to create an educational resource. Over six years, more than 40,000 pounds of produce were harvested while 2,200 students participated in learning experiences.

articles.title: Kurt Cobain’s Olympia apartment is now an Airbnb
articles.summary: Kurt Cobain's former apartment in Olympia is now available for booking on Airbnb, allowing fans to immerse themselves in a pivotal chapter of music history. This space showcases original fixtures and memorabilia, offering an authentic glimpse into Cobain's life during Nirvana's formative years.

articles.title: Salman Khan fan rushes towards him at Prem Keetanu screening
articles.summary: Salman Khan had an unexpected encounter with an over-excited fan during a screening of 'Prem Keetanu'. The fan managed to approach him despite multiple security personnel being present, which startled the actor.

articles.title: Police did wellness check on Hayden Panettiere week before her passing
articles.summary: In a tragic turn of events, Hayden Panettiere was subjected to a wellness check on August 16, prompted by a concerned caller worried about her silence. Following the discovery of her unresponsive state, it was determined that her death resulted from multiple drug toxicities, but no foul play was evident.
